compiled_state.title: As a bridge operator, I want banded bootstrap of orphan anomalies, so that the 1,264 orphan fsck findings are reviewed and remediated against a dry-run manifest before any Jira mutation.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Walking-skeleton bootstrap band #1. Enumerates orphan anomalies (local-only or jira-only with no cross-mapping), emits per-class dry-run manifest, blocks on operator attestation, then applies remediations. Covers orphan band only.

## Done Definitions
- An orphan-band dry-run manifest enumerates every orphan anomaly with class label, side (local-only or jira-only), and proposed remediation, written to bridge_state/bootstrap/orphans-<pass>.manifest.json ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The manifest blocks applier execution until a reviewer attestation file is present in bridge_state/bootstrap/orphans-<pass>.attested.json ← Satisfies: sc-1
- After attestation, the applier mutates Jira and/or the local tracker per the manifest, and the post-pass orphan count drops to zero or to a reviewer-acknowledged residual ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations
- [Reliability] First-week tightening caps mutations at 10/pass for 7 days; surface 'manifest exceeds cap, will split across passes' rather than failing.
- [Security] Reviewer attestation must be signed (committer identity) so an autonomous agent cannot self-attest.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
